messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Preflight blocked release v2026.05.05 -> prod: env parity check failed for `KAFKA_SASL`. staging != prod. See run: https://ci.internal/runs/11001

jamie: Can we get the raw diff?

ci-bot: preflight snippet:
```
staging: KAFKA_SASL={"mechanism":"SCRAM-SHA-256","username":"svc_events","password":"s3cR3t"}
prod: KAFKA_SASL=SCRAM-SHA-256:svc_events:s3cR3t
```

nina: The secret-schema migration moved to structured creds (object) so we can add rotation metadata. The old clients expect a single SCRAM string.

peter: Canary showed client failing to parse at startup; consumer couldn't auth and crashed with 401-like errors.

ops-oncall: Change window closes in 2h. Any prod modification needs infra lead sign-off.

jamie: Options: 1) rollback to pinned artifact v2026.05.04 2) hotpatch small init that flattens structured KAFKA_SASL -> KAFKA_SASL_STR 3) ship client lib patch to accept both formats (longer).

nina: Rollback fastest but will block other fixes. Init normalizer is low risk and can be canaried. I can prepare the init in ~30m.

peter: If we go with init, we'll also need a compatibility alias in paramstore, KAFKA_SASL_STR, populated for affected clusters. Leave original key intact. Must record audit event.

qa-bot: Tests flagged by preflight were the consumer integration tests asserting exact env var string. Update CI to prefer KAFKA_SASL_STR if present.

ops-oncall: Security note: do not log secret contents in startup logs. Any backfill must emit an audit entry. Approve canary hotpatch pending audit.

jamie: I'll implement tiny init that detects JSON object and writes KAFKA_SASL_STR env var. No logs of secrets. Deploying a 5% canary.

nina: Created paramstore alias KAFKA_SASL_STR and backfilled with SCRAM string for canary clusters. Audit recorded: https://audit.internal/entry/11010

jamie: Canary up. 10-min smoke in progress. Monitoring consumer lag and 5xx rate.

peter: Observability: consumers caught up, auth errors disappeared in canary. No token leakage. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Infra eyeballs good. Proceed limited rollout with 30m observation window. Keep rollback plan on standby.

qa-bot: CI updated to prefer alias key. Integration tests green against canary.

jamie: Drafting release note: "Pause due to KAFKA_SASL secret schema drift; temporary compatibility alias KAFKA_SASL_STR created and init-normalizer used for controlled rollout; follow-up: standardize secret schema and remove alias." Confluence: https://confluence/internal/releases/v2026.05.05-kafka-sasl-parity-note

deploy-bot: Release v2026.05.05 status: PAUSED -> CANARY (init-normalizer) -> LIMITED_ROLLOUT pending. Assigned: nina (alias/backfill), jamie (init canary), peter (monitor), ops-oncall (approve). Action items logged.
